resources.string: Update checks prefer an official public manifest, so releases remain discoverable when the GitHub API is temporarily rate-limited. The manifest includes the signing-certificate fingerprint; the official APK URL, size, SHA-256, package, version code and original signature are verified. A recent valid result can be used during a short network outage; repeated checks are throttled, while a manual check retries immediately. An older remote manifest cannot offer a downgrade. Storage is checked before downloading; after interruption or cancellation, a matching partial file can resume when the server supports it, and the completed APK is still fully verified.
